task_instance: Create and deploy a minimal Gradio 'text reverser' app to a new Hugging Face Space (hf repos create ... --type space --space-sdk gradio, then hf upload).
blocker_detail: Deploying to Hugging Face Spaces requires an authenticated HF account: `hf auth whoami` returned 'Error: Not logged in', and `hf auth login` needs either an interactive OAuth device-code flow (a human opening a URL in a browser) or a write-scoped API token from huggingface.co/settings/tokens. The sandbox rules forbid using or searching for credentials/tokens and forbid account-bound services, so `hf repos create <ns>/<name> --type space` and `hf upload` could not be run. I could only prepare the local app files (README frontmatter, app.py, requirements.txt) that would be pushed once authenticated.
evidence: Verified `which hf` -> /usr/local/bin/hf; `pip show huggingface_hub` -> version 1.33.0 installed. Ran `hf auth whoami` -> 'Error: Not logged in'. Created sample Space files at sample-space/README.md (with sdk: gradio frontmatter), sample-space/app.py (Gradio Interface with reverse_text function), sample-space/requirements.txt. Verified app.py syntax with `python3 -m py_compile sample-space/app.py` -> COMPILE_OK. Could not proceed past this point because `hf repos create` and `hf upload` both require a logged-in HF identity, which requires interactive OAuth login or a personal access token — both disallowed by the safety rules (no credentials/tokens, no account-bound services).
